The TP in draft CR R1-2406339 for TS38.213 on correcting Type-2 HARQ-ACK codebook determination is agreed as alignment CR.
UE behaviour is undefined for the case where there is not a bit in a HARQ-ACK codebook for the issue discussed in R1-2402707. No specification change for this case.

The text proposal for correction on HARQ-ACK generation for DL transmission with single TB when multi-TB is configured is endorsed. Final CRs are agreed for TS38.213 in R1-2009536 (TS38.213, Rel-15, CR#0157, Cat. F) and R1-2009537 (TS38.213, Rel-16, CR#0158, Cat. A).
